caption: Two pieces of flint are struck together in the dark, and a tiny spark jumps between them.

sa.check: Two pieces of flint, held in the dark.
A tiny spark jumps between them.
The scene is dark before the strike.
The strike comes first and the spark follows.

pc.expect: The spark appears at the point of impact at the instant of the strike, and is gone; nothing glows before or after.
pc.fail: The spark glows on between the pieces after the strike; or a spark appears while the pieces are apart and still; or a piece of flint glows after the strike; or the spark drifts away as a lit point.

pc.expect: Two pieces of flint throughout; the spark leaves nothing behind.
pc.fail: A third piece appears or a piece vanishes; or a glowing dot stays in the air after the spark; or the pieces merge into one; or the spark leaves a lit trail.

pc.expect: Any spark fragments fall from the strike point and go dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Sparks rise and gather above the hands; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the ground for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: During the spark the hands and the flint nearest to it brighten briefly; the rest stays dark.
pc.fail: The spark is visible while the hands and flint around it stay as dark as before; or the whole scene lights up as if a lamp came on; or the surroundings stay lit after the spark is gone.

pc.expect: The pieces meet at their surfaces and rebound or stop; neither passes through the other or through the hands.
pc.fail: One piece passes through the other; or a piece passes through a hand; or the flints melt or bend; or a piece vanishes at the strike.

pc.expect: The flints' colour and shape and the dark background stay the same.
pc.fail: A flint changes colour or shape between strikes; or the background rearranges; or the hands change.

note: The hands are kept because striking is the caption's action; how they hold the flint is not judged.
